pūrṇa candraḥ guruḥ caret mahāvaiśākhika ādyāḥ tu pūrṇimāḥ dvādaśa smṛtāḥ mahājyaiṣṭhī viśeṣaḥ ayam prājāpatye yathā raviḥ guru pūrṇa candraḥ jyeṣṭhāyām mahājyaiṣṭhī iti sā smṛtā vinā api guruṇā candraḥ kṛttikā pūrṇimā tathā tathā mahākārttikī sā tithiḥ puṇyatamā bhavet rohiṇyām tu sthitaḥ candraḥ paurṇamāsyām tu kārttike citrā vā yadi vā pūrṇā yadā syāt pūrṇimā atithiḥ mahācaitrī tathā api syāt aśvamedha phala pradā raviṇā kṛttikā yogāt ravi vāre ca pūrṇimā mahācaitrī tathā api syāt dattasya akṣaya kārikā sarvam akṣaya tām yāti phalam ca eva āśvamedhikam pitaraḥ tarpitāḥ yāṃti vaiṣṇavam mahāśrāvaṇī kedāre mahā puṇyatamā matā mahābhādrī badaryām ca syāt naraḥ tathā mahatī mārgaśīrṣe syāt ayodhyāyām tathā uttare mahāpauṣī puṇyatamā mahāmāghī prayāgataḥ mahāphālgunī naimiṣe ca nirdiṣṭāḥ syuḥ mahā phalāḥ āśvine paurṇamāsī tu kaumudī iti prakīrtitā asyām candra udaye lakṣmīm pūjayet vidhivat naraḥ yaḥ śrāddham prabhāte paitṛkam dvijaḥ indu kṣaye māsi māsi prāyaścittīyate tu saḥ candra āśvine tu kṛṣṇāyām pañcadaśyām yathāvidhi kṛtvā snāna ādikam karma sa upavāsaḥ dinam nayet pradoṣa samaye lakṣmīm pūjayitvā yathāvidhi dīpavṛkṣān yathā vṛkṣān lakṣmī prītyai samutsṛjet nadī tīre girau goṣṭhe śmaśāne vṛkṣa mūlataḥ dvis bhojanam amāvāsyām na kartavyam kadācana śarvaryām ca viśeṣeṇa māgha phālgunayoḥ naraiḥ sūtaḥ uvāca vakṣye pravara saṃtānam yathākramam iti dvijāḥ yat vinā vyatyayaḥ yasmāt tasmāt śāstra anusārataḥ pravara trayam kāśyapasya kāśyapa āśā vanaiḥ dhruvam mokunī āṃgirasa bhāsyāt jāmadagnya āplavāyanam śāṃḍilya asita daivalāḥ pravara trayam eva ca parāśarasya ca tathā svayam śāṃbavaśiṣṭhakam ātreyam ācāryaṇasya a bāla pravaram eva hi artha kṣīra mitrāvaruṇam pañcamam parikīrtitam autathyasya ca vāśiṣṭham aindre cakram ca krauñcāyanam tathā autathya iti samākhyātam puṣpaiḥ prapūjayet pūrva ādi dvāra deśe tu pūjayet ca marut gaṇaiḥ tatas maṇḍala madhye tu vāruṇam pūrva vartmanā kūrmam kūrma ākṛtim kuryāt śuddha svarṇena sattamāḥ pādam pādena mānena aṃgulam parimaṇḍalam prauṣṭhī matsyam tathā kuryāt kulīram tāmra nirmitam tena ekasya vinirmāṇam dvi aṃgula āyāma vistṛtam tathā mānena maṇḍūkam tām bhūmim muni sattamāḥ yāvakaiḥ ca viśeṣeṇa bahu maṃtra viśāradān pañca aṃgam śivasūktam ca yathā viṣṇoḥ harasya ca jaya agratas puruṣasūktam adbhyaḥ saṃbhūtam eva ca āśuḥ śiśānam ārabhya vayam moṣa aṃga rudrake yat jāgrataḥ ca agneḥ ca viṣṇoḥ arāṭam eva ca samasta adhyāya rudreṇa śata rudra ākhyam īritam sapta aṃga rudrasya puṣpadaṃta ṛṣiḥ paṃktiḥ chaṃdaḥ tryaṃbakam iti aṃguṣṭhābhyām namaḥ tripād ūrdhvam iti tarjanībhyām svāhā veda aham iti madhyamābhyām vaṣaṭ amīṣām citram iti anāmikābhyām hum yavāgūm somaḥ iti kaniṣṭhikābhyām vauṣaṭ yat jāgrataḥ iti hṛdayāya namaḥ sahasra śīrṣā iti śirase svāhā adbhyaḥ saṃbhūtaḥ iti śikhāyai vaṣaṭ āśuḥ śiśānaḥ iti kavacābhyām huṃ namaḥ te rudraḥ iti netratrayāya vauṣaṭ rūḍham brahman iti astrāya phaṭ catur dikṣu choṭikāṃdānam iti sarva aṃgeṣu home pravartamāne tu sūktān anyān ca vai japet prajapet vāruṇam sūktam tathā ca pālasūktakam gāyaṃtam brāhmaṇāḥ ye ca pūrva ādi dvāra deśataḥ rudrādhyāyam ca pañca aṃgam raudraḥ iti abhidhīyate āpyāyasva iti ca catuḥ saumyam sūktam pracakṣate īśāva ityādi sva aṃgam ca kauṣmāṃḍam daśamam smṛtam ṣoḍaśam tu vibhrāj vṛhat sauram sūktam prakīrtitam saura sūktam iṣavaḥ maṃgalam smṛtam rātrisūktam hi yajva agne rakṣaḥ ghnam śaiva sūktakam gaṇānām tvā iti pañca āpohiṣṭhā iti ca trayam pavamānam tu tat viddhi pāvamānam tu ṣoḍaśa tad arddha arddham ca ārāme kūpe tu ekaṛcam japet saṃskuryāt dīkṣaṇa ādyaiḥ ca saṃpūjya ca parasparam vāgīśvaram samabhyarcya vāgīśvaryā samanvitam prāk eva tasya juhuyāt sahasram ca śatam tathā tila ājyaiḥ pāyasaiḥ vā atha patra puṣpa akṣatena ca ūrjena samidhā kuryāt aṣṭa aṣṭau sva gṛheṣu api indra īśvara mārutānām tila ājyena ghṛtena vā ekaikām āhutim dadyāt svaiḥ maṃtraiḥ yathākramāt digīśānām ca pratyekam aṣṭa aṣṭau ca viśeṣataḥ ekaikām āhutim dadyāt ājyena ca viśeṣataḥ sarasvatīm ca vidhivat pṛthivyai iti pāvakaiḥ bhūtebhyaḥ api āhutim dadyāt evam māsa dvayam kramāt anyeṣām madhura aktena tila lājaiḥ yayā akramam viṣṇum ca eva tu vāyavye durgāyāḥ ca tathā uttare kamalāyāḥ ca īśāne īśānasya sa bhūtakam pakṣe vai pañca kuṇḍe tu pūrva ādīnām krameṇa tu eka kuṃḍe grahān kṛtvā kṛtvā balabhidā saha paścime yasya yāgasya durgāyāḥ ca uttare diśi īśāne bhūtayakṣmā ca juhuyāt deśika uttamaḥ viṣṇu ādi devatānām ca agra kuṃḍe vidhīyate bali dānam tṛtīye tu caturthīkam caturthake nīrājanam pañcame tu pañca aha sādhyakaḥ vidhiḥ prādakṣiṇyena yajñam tu mantraiḥ parisamūhanam mantra pūrvam sa agnikānām niragneḥ tuṣṭikena tu diś vidikṣu paristīrya mahā yāgeṣu sarvadā māraṇa uccāṭa homeṣu tathā saṃkalpita ākṛtī pratyavāya kule kvāpi tatra nitya ākṛtim vinā tūrya homam tatas kṛtvā tūṣṇīm eva jita indriyaḥ ante sviṣṭakṛtam dadyāt vidhānam tasya bhoḥ śṛṇu ghṛta āhutim sviṣṭakṛt ca dvija saṃskāra karmasu ghṛtaiḥ sviṣṭakṛtam dadyāt yāga ādau parivarjayet sarva oṣadhi udaka snānam kari danta uttham uṣṇayā tri gandham ca tri śītam ca kuśa mūlasya mṛttikāḥ nikṣipet snāna kumbheṣu ācārya ādīn tu sthāpayet yajamānaḥ puras kṛtvā daṃta kāṣṭha puraḥsaram rātrau ca bhakṣya bhojya ādyaiḥ paritoṣya yava akṣatam kṛtvā yathā ukta kālena pūjayet taila dhārayā vāruṇena ca sūktena surāstu ādi yathākramam ācāryāya abhirūpāya pradadiyāt abhipūjayan śuddhām ca kapilām dogdhrīm ghaṭa ācāmara varjitām sāmagāya tatas dadyāt suvarṇa dakṣiṇā anvitām yūpam ādāya saṃsthāpya snāpayet vāruṇam japan parvata agra mṛdā toya nāga valmīka jātayā ca eva dāpayet kāṃsya mūlam ca dadyāt loha mayam ca vā īśāvā iti maṃtreṇa dadyāt puṣpa añjali trayam maṃtreṇa punar puṣpam samutsṛjet prādeśa mātra vistāram madhye vṛttam ṣaṣ aṃgulam kāṃsya cakrasya mānam tu ūrdhvam yat dvādaśa aṃgulam aṃguṣṭha hīne lohasya tatra śūlam na kārayet tatas maṃgala pūrve tu dvijātīnām matena ca samutsṛjet ca prāsādam taḍāgam ca viśeṣataḥ catur darbham gṛhītvā tu īśāna abhimukhena tu samutsṛjet tatas paścāt vākyam etat urīyet om ityādi śrī kṛṣṇadvaipāyana abhidhāna vedavyāsa praṇīta bhaviṣya purāṇa ukta phala prapti kāmaḥ catuṣkoṇa ādi avacchinna mat kārita puṣkariṇī jalam etat ūrjitam gaṃdha puṣpa ādi arcitam varuṇa daivatam sarva sattvebhyaḥ snāna avagāhana artham aham utsṛje tatas varuṇasūktena varuṇam nāga saṃyutam pūjayet varuṇam devam arghyam dadyāt viśeṣataḥ śvetāśva sura saṃbhūtam śrīḥ ca tā iti ca saṃjapan āpyāyasva iti maṃtreṇa mṛdam catuṣpatha udbhavām tat viṣṇoḥ iti maṃtreṇa kuśa mūlena sthāpayet tīrtha toyena gaṃdhena tathā pañcāmṛtena ca gāyatryā snāpayet devam ratna toyena sādhakaḥ āpyāyasva iti maṃtreṇa kṣīreṇa tad anantaram sarasvatyām tā iti jātī puṣpa toyena snāpayet śrīḥ ca te iti maṃtrasya kardamaḥ ṛṣiḥ paṃktiḥ chaṃdaḥ sarit devatā aśva khura mṛdā snāne viniyogaḥ āpyāyasva iti maṃtrasya parvataḥ ṛṣiḥ uṣṇih chandaḥ sarasvatī devatā varuṇa prītaye catuṣpatha mṛdā snāne viniyogaḥ tat viṣṇoḥ iti maṃtrasya mainākaḥ ṛṣiḥ triṣṭubh chandaḥ sarasvatī devatā varuṇa prītaye kuśa mṛdā snāne viniyogaḥ kayā naḥ iti maṃtrasya vasiṣṭhaḥ ṛṣiḥ anuṣṭubh chandaḥ somaḥ devatā varuṇa prītaye nāga gaṃdha snāne viniyogaḥ maṃtrasya gargaḥ ṛṣiḥ triṣṭubh chandaḥ vāsavaḥ devatā varuṇa prītaye viniyogaḥ sarasvatyai bhaiṣajyena iti maṃtrasya vāmadevaḥ ṛṣiḥ paṃktiḥ chaṃdaḥ viṣṇuḥ devatā varuṇa prītaye viniyogaḥ agne āyāhi iti maṃtrasya janārdanaḥ ṛṣiḥ jagatī chandaḥ aindrī devatā varuṇa prītaye viniyogaḥ prakṣipet pañca vrīhīn ca iyat ca iti ca saṃpaṭhan śirīṣa puṣpa saṃbhūtam darpaṇam kāsya saṃbhavam gopīcandana saṃbhūtam gaṃgā mṛttikayā atha vā kṛṣṇām gām gomayam vā api svastikam śaṃkham eva ca utpanna svarga saṃbhūtam kalaśam māṣa saṃbhavam śrīrasam puṣpasaṃbhūtam darpaṇam kāṃsyasaṃbhavam pūrva akṣatam māṣa bhakta balim dadyāt vidhānataḥ tatas nārāyaṇasūktena devam nārāyaṇam vrajet anyeṣām ca eva devānām pradadyāt triṃśatam balim pṛthak pṛthak tatas dadyāt tāvaṃtyena api bho dvijāḥ aṣṭottaraśatān dīpān paritas sthāpayet kramāt tad ardham vā pañcaviṃśam maṃtreṇa prayajet sudhīḥ tvam sūryya candra jyotīṃṣi viṣādaḥ tvam tathā eva ca vakṣyamāṇena maṃtreṇa dadyāt dhūpam daśa aṃgakam vanaspati rasaḥ divyaḥ gaṃdha āḍhyaḥ surabhiḥ śuciḥ dūrvā akṣatena mālyena yuktam puṣpeṇa pūjayet dadyāt pañca añjalim paścāt viṣṇusūktam punar japet tatas su śobhane sthāne vedīm nirmāya deśikaḥ varuṇam vinyaset tatra tathā puṣkariṇīm api gaṃdha puṣpam tatas dadyāt gām ca dadyāt sa dakṣiṇām cāmaram vyajanam chatram kāṃsyam loham tathā eva ca kuryāt puṣkariṇīm ramyām rājatīm ca tripādikām catuṣkoṇām ca suṣamām dvi aṃguṣṭha parimaṃḍalām suvarṇa pratimām kuryāt bhālena ekena bho drijāḥ bāṇa śakti pramāṇena svarṇa patram tu dvi aṃgulam nīrājana aṃte vipra iṃdrāḥ saṃsmaret amṛtam taret prāṇa pratiṣṭhām kuryāt tu varuṇāya nivedayet aśokaḥ khadiraḥ śālaḥ hi aśvatthaḥ bilvakaḥ tathā dhātrī kurubakaḥ ca eva bakulaḥ nāgakeśaraḥ eṣām eva kāṣṭha yūpam yajamāna pramāṇakam samādāya ca saṃsthāpya vastra ādyaiḥ pratigṛhya ca yūpa rakṣa iti maṃtreṇa khanitvā ca pradāpayet taḍāgasya tathā aiśānyām tathā prāsādakasya ca prāpayet dakṣiṇe bhāge āvāsasya ca madhyake naukāḥ gatvā tatas paścāt yūpam ādāya vāgyataḥ catur asram samākīrṇam catur dikṣu adhṛtaiḥ janaiḥ cakram sa darpaṇam dadyāt nāgadaṃḍa śiraḥ gataḥ evam cakram pūjayitvā śūlam nāgān ca pūjayet uccais dhvajam tatas kṛtvā na nāga iti ca saṃpaṭhet maṃtreṇa paṭhet dvāra dvayam tatas dikpālebhyaḥ balim dadyāt māṣa bhaktam guḍa odanam rakta puṣpa anvitam kṛtvā praṇipatya prasādayet ikṣusvastītikām dadyāt jale mātṝḥ ca pūjayet maṃtharām vasutām kāṃtām rākṣasīm ca piśācikām nāginīḥ nāgaputrān ca madhye saṃpūjayet tatas pūrṇa aṃte ca pṛthak dadyāt lāja ādyaiḥ guḍa miśritaiḥ madhyame ca kanīyake svāhā iti juhuyāt paścāt praṇītām cālayet tatas kaniṣṭha pakṣe prāsāde tathā ca eva jalāśaye ārāme ca tathā setau viśeṣaḥ pañcamaḥ dvijāḥ iti paṭhitvā puṣkariṇī jalam haste gṛhītvā jale kṣipet trailokye yāni sthānāni sthāvarāṇi carāṇi ca teṣām āpyāyanāya etat jalam utsṛjyate mayā śivāya sarva bhūtānām sadā pāhi jalāśayam pibaṃtaḥ hi avagāhaṃtaḥ sukhinaḥ sarva jaṃtavaḥ jalam viśva upakārāya kṛtam etat mayā sadā kīrtiḥ tiṣṭhatu me devāḥ cirāya dharaṇī tale teṣām doṣaiḥ na lipye aham svam svam gamam avāpnuyāt āpeyāḥ mātaraḥ saṃtu jagatām vṛkṣa yonayaḥ apāṃpate rasāya atra yādasām īśvara prabho varuṇa asya āsane kīrtim sanātana namaḥ astu te suvarṇam rajatam dadyāt anaḍvāham payasvinīm dadyāt dhenu dvayam paścāt kuryāt brāhmaṇa tarpaṇam vahni pūjām puraskṛtya mantreṇa prāśayet tatas pitṛrṇām dāpayet arghyam tatas devam prasādayet vaiśvānarāḥ iti ṛcā pūjām kṛtvā vivarjayet yaḥ te prāṇān japan paścāt prakuryāt atha candanam pradakṣiṇam tatas paścāt taḍāgasya śṛṇu dvijāḥ brāhmaṇān puratas kṛtvā veda ghoṣam samuccaran mahā maṅgala pūrveṇa praviśet bhavanam sudhīḥ dīnānām kṛpaṇānām ca savitre arghyam nivedayet śūtaḥ uvāca adhunā madhyamam vakṣye vidhim śāstra anusārataḥ muhūrte kalaśam sthāpya saṃgṛhya gaṇanāyakam sthāpayet prathamam yūpam ā pohiṣṭhā iti mantrakaiḥ devyāḥ tatas paścāt gandha dvāra iti gaṃdhakam śrīsūktena tatas dadyāt puṣpam dūrvā akṣatam tatas kāṇḍāt iti ca mantreṇa tatas dhūpam nivedayet ye gṛhṇāmi iti ca ṛcā pūjāyām sthāpayet tatas sarvam eva prayuṃjīta taḍāga ādiṣu paṇḍitaḥ adhivāsya taḍāga ādīn ācārya ādīn ca sarvaśas vṛddhiśrāddham tatas kuryāt mātṛ pūjā puraḥsaram alaṃkṛtya yathāśakti ācārya ādīn caret budhaḥ śṛṇuyāt paścime bhāge maṃḍapasya samīpatas madhyadeśe samudbhūtam yajña pātram praśasyate atha vā tatra deśīyam gurum vā śrotriya udbhavam yajñe pradhāna dvitīyam ṛtvij ācāryam eva hi vaitāna kalpe saṃpannam śakti kalpa parāyaṇam nigama jñāna saṃpannam yajñe pātram praśasyate patnī hīnam aputram ca śyāva daṃtam adaṃtakam gaṇānām yājakam ṣaṃḍham sva gotram parivarjayet apradhāneṣu yajñeṣu dāna yajñeṣu sattamāḥ dhanam ādau ca saṃśodhya tatas yajñam samācaret a yājya yājana udbhūtam pallavam vyavahārake kūṭa sākṣyeṇa pallave sthāpya hārakam eva ca haviḥ vikrayaṇam kṛtvā putra bhāryā divikrayī niṃditāni purāṇeṣu yat kṛtam tatra tad phalam yajña sadmani viprān ca na śrāddhān bhojayet kvacid brahman ācārya mukhyaḥ asi saṃsārāt trāhi mām vibho tvad prasādāt guro yajñe prāpnuyām mānasa īpsitam ciram me śāśvatī kīrtiḥ yāvat lokāḥ cara acarāḥ prasīda tvam maheśāna pratiṣṭhā karma siddhaye jñāna amṛta prada ācārya viṣṇu rūpa namaḥ astu te brahmāsana samudbhūtam prakāśita digaṃtaram prakīrṇa śāstra saṃbhāra vidhi jña praṇataḥ asmi te jvalat vaiśvānara prakhya dhūma śyāma ālita ānana ṣaṣ aṃga veda tattva jñaḥ ṛtvij mokṣam samācara tatas tūrya ādi ghoṣeṇa puraskṛtya dvijottamān yajamānaḥ sa patnīkaḥ praviśet yāga maṇḍapam pūjayet gandha mālya ādyaiḥ gaṃdha ādyaiḥ su manoharaiḥ nārāyaṇa sva rūpā usau yajñam me saphalam kuru makha śreṣṭheṣu sarveṣu yena maṃtrāḥ su vistṛtāḥ yajñeṣu sākṣī sarveṣu veda veda artha tattva vid ṛgveda jña mahā prājña viśvarūpa namaḥ astu te māṃgalyam karmaṇām nityam śāśvatam brahma rūpiṇam dikpāla rūpiṇam vipram yajña siddhyai namāmi aham pātayet dakṣiṇam jānu vikirān vikiret tatas vedyāvedī iti maṃtreṇa paṭhet vedim praṇamya ca yājanam yajamānaḥ ca śreyasā tatra yājakaḥ idam arghyam idam pādyam dhūpaḥ yam pratigṛhyatām aiśānyām kalaśe devam saṃpūjya gaṇa nāyakam brahmāṇam vāsudevam ca dvitīya kalaśe yajet maṃḍalam ca eva viṣṇuḥ vai dvārakā rūpam āsthitaḥ tena tvām pūjayāmi adya svarga prāptim kuruṣva me pūrva ādi dikṣu kalaśān saṃsthāpya ca trayam trayam ardha pāda savarṇena nirmitam tāraṇam budhaḥ maṃdaram kalpayitvā tu gopīnām ca kulena vā kalaśa upari saṃsthāpya maṃdaram saṃprapūjayet syonā pṛthivī iti maṃtreṇa gaṃdha puṣpaiḥ pṛthigvidhaiḥ prādeśa mātra loham tu raupyeṇa gaṃdhamādanam mṛdā saṃghaṭanaiḥ paścāt kadācana ṛcā yajet kadācana iti maṃtrasya sūryaḥ ṛṣiḥ triṣṭubh chandaḥ sūryaḥ devatā gaṃdhamādana prītaye viniyogaḥ tolaka dvaya mānena yavānām piṣṭaka upari pūjayet pārśva kalaśe dhātṛ ādīn pūrva diś kramāt aṃbā aṃbikā iti maṃtrasya nalinaḥ ṛṣiḥ gāyatrī chandaḥ śaṃbhuḥ devatā jaya prītaye viniyogaḥ gāyatryā pūjayet dakṣe paścimam kalaśa dvayam bhūtaśuddhim tatas kṛtvā nyāsam kṛtvā vidhānataḥ vidhāya arghya ādikam ca eva dharma ādi maṃḍale yajet madhye ādhāra śakti ādīn varuṇam madhyatas yajet pūrva ādi kramataḥ ca eva indra ādīn kuladevatāḥ pārśva dvaye karṇikāyāḥ brahmāṇam ca api anantakam indra abhiṣeka maṃtrasya vādyam gāṃdhāra rāgakam vādyam rāgam ca eva varāṭakam ghanakaṃṭakam asya api vācyam rāgam tu gurjaram rakṣaḥ adhipasya saṃgrāmam vaitālam vādyam ucyate nāṭaka ākhyam tathā rāgam varuṇasya api me śṛṇu vādyam rājya abhiṣeka ākhyam rāgaḥ vasaṃta saṃjñakaḥ īśasya naṃdighoṣa ākhyam vādyam kāmadaḥ suvarṇam duṃdubhiḥ vādyam brahmaṇaḥ kathitaḥ budhaiḥ vādyam gāṃdhāra tāra ākhyam rāgaḥ ca aṅgāravātakaḥ some ghoṣe bhavet vādyam jaleśasya mahātmanaḥ mālava ākhyaḥ bhavet rāgaḥ patra agreṣu mahān api svaiḥ svaiḥ dharmaiḥ ca saṃgṛhya dakṣiṇe pṛthivīm yajet syonā pṛthivī iti maṃtreṇa upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ maṇḍapasya uttare bhāge mahādevam prapūjayet asmāt prayāṃtu me sthānāt ye ca anye vighna kārakāḥ madhu yuktam pāyasa annam varuṇāya nivedayet pītam ca ālohitam kṛṣṇam śuddham kṛṣṇam ca dhūmrakam pītam śuklam tathā citram śvetam annam yathākramam balayaḥ tu digīśānām grahāṇām api tān śṛṇu kṣīraudanam graheśāya śukla annam śaśine smṛtam lohitānnam ca bhaumāya budhāya kṣīraṣāṣṭikam māṃsaudanam śaneḥ jñeyam rāhoḥ ca kṛṣṇa bhaktakam dhūmra varṇam tu tāmram tu bhaumasya kṣīraṣāṣṭikam piṣṭaka annam śivasya uktam bhūtānām māṣa bhaktakam evam balim vidhāya atha agre kuṃbham niveśayet pradeśa dvyaṅgulam nāma aṣṭottarasahasrakam niśāvāṃchti sūtraiḥ ca saṃveṣṭya pihitam tathā śarāvam ca punar dadyāt vardhanīm pratipūjayet astrāya phaṭ iti maṃtreṇa dhyātvā devam jaleśvaram sūktam yajet yathāśakti śatam aṣṭa uttaram japet kuṃḍeṣu vinyaset nāgān aṣṭau pūrva ādiṣu kramāt anantam pūjayet pūrvam mānena aṃgula mātrakam nirmitam kāṃcanena eva sapta vartikayā sudhīḥ rājatam vāsukim nāgam yajet patra antare punar pāda mātre api ca aṃguṣṭha mātram tāmrasya bhakṣyakam paṃca aṃgulam tolikayā loham karkoṭakam punar vartikābhiḥ ṣoḍaśabhiḥ bṛhat parva pramāṇakam śaṃkhapālam kuśa mayam ardha pādena nirmitam aṃguṣṭha mātram raktena nāgam tālaka mātrakam aṃguṣṭhe tolakam paścāt padma nāgam punar yajet tolaka ardha pramāṇena aṃgulam parimāṇataḥ dhyātvā anaṃtam catur bāhum śukla sapta phaṇa anvitam dakṣiṇa ūrdhva kare śaṃkham adhi cakram pratiṣṭhitam sarva alaṃkāra saṃyuktam evam dhyātvā yathāvidhi sahasra śīrṣa iti maṃtreṇa pūjayitvā balim haret lājaiḥ ca tila saṃmiśraiḥ kṣīra yuktaiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ svakīyam prajapet tatra āpyāyasva iti vai ṛcā piṇyākam nāgajihvām ca tathā sarjarasam dadhi padmam ṭaṃkam dadhānam ca bhujābhyām nāga sattamam manaḥ unnāḥ iti maṃtreṇa ājyam somaḥ balim haret pañca nadyaḥ iti ṛcā viṣṇukrāntā baliḥ bhavet śarkarā kuṣṭhakam ca eva baliḥ tasya prakī rtitaḥ dvi bhujam śaṃkhapālam ca śaṃkha ābham śaṃkha dhāriṇam padmāsana stham padmābhyām hastābhyām ca varam vibhum maṃtrābhyām pūjayet pṛthak ghaṭaudanam bhṛṃgarājam padmam ca valayaḥ tayoḥ sva gṛhya uktena vidhinā saṃsthāpya agnim kuśaṃḍikām kṛtvā ājyasya saṃskāram vāruṇam śrapayet carum juhuyāt aṣṭa bilvāni digīśānām ghṛtena vai ekaikām āhutim dadyāt grahāṇām ca trayam trayam palāśa samidham paścāt pratiṣṭhām āhuti trayam śivasya paramānnena juhuyāt aṣṭa saṃkhyayā madhu ājya guḍa miśrābhiḥ lājābhiḥ juhuyāt pṛthak lājāni athoktam vitaret ekaikām āhutim kramāt sthālīpākasya juhuyāt ekaikām āhutim punar varuṇam ca samuddiśya rudram sarvam pṛthak pṛthak syonā pṛthivī iti maṃtreṇa vrīhimṛttikayā punar vṛṣān naḥ iti maṃtreṇa kayā naḥ iti vai punar kuśa mūla mṛdā ca eva catuṣpatha mṛdā tathā imāḥ rudra iti maṃtreṇa śrīḥ ca iti ṛcā punar padma khaṇḍasya ca mṛdā snāpayet su samāhitaḥ tat viṣṇoḥ iti maṃtreṇa tathā puṣpa udakena ca tīrtha udakena kṛṣṇena tri raktena tri śītakaiḥ pañca raktena raktānām mṛdā kaiḥ ca kuśa udakaiḥ svarṇa toyaiḥ ca kalaśaiḥ aṣṭottaraśatena tu taijasaiḥ mārttikaiḥ ca api aṣṭāviṃśatibhiḥ tathā dhūḥ asi iti tatas dhūpam hotre ca āhuti dīpakam ca siṃdūram svabhāve raktakam tathā mālatī kusumaiḥ kṛtyaiḥ nāgān saṃsthāpayet tatas dhārābhiḥ śata puṣpābhiḥ gandha toya ādibhiḥ tathā athavā aśvattha patreṣu vaṭa patreṣu vā sudhīḥ maṃḍapasya uttare deśe śayyām nirmāya śobhanām rājatam vāruṇam tasyām pāda mātreṇa nirmitām aṃguṣṭha mātram saṃsthāpya tatas puṣkariṇīm api svarṇa pādena ghaṭitām catur asrām su śobhanām aṃguṣṭha mātram sampūjya varuṇāya nivedayet yathāśakti tatas gām ca saṃbhave pañcaviṃśatiḥ nāga yaṣṭim samādāya kiṃcid uttara gām tathā tatas ukṣatāya bhaumāya kṛtvā ca ājya āhuti trayam lājān dadhi samāyuktam ghṛtam madhu guḍam tathā kṣīram ca piṣṭakam ca eva śaṣkulī gandhapuṣpakam paṃcāmṛtam pañcaratnam garbhe dadyāt samāhitaḥ gaṃgā jaleśayoḥ madhye paṃca ghoṣa puraḥsaram dhruvam dhruva iti maṃtreṇa yaṣṭimā maṃtrayet tatas yajña priyā asi devi tvam sarva vighna vināśinī pāhi mām sarva pāpebhyaḥ ātmanā tvam sthirībhava iti āmaṃtrya yajet ca eva gāyatrīm ca paṭhet tatas tathā puṣkariṇīm ca eva vardhanīm kalaśa udaraiḥ aniṣṭam mārjayet nāgān uddhṛtya kalaśam tathā pāṣāṇa abhyaṃtaram kṛtvā gomayaiḥ parilipya ca varuṇam puṣkariṇyām ca jala madhye vinikṣipet atra svāmī bhavān nāga rakṣaṇīyaḥ tvayā janaḥ gāyatreṇa tvā chaṃdasā amīmantram saṃśrāvayet punar saṃpūjya gaṃdha puṣpa ādyaiḥ puratas nikṣipet diśi pidhāya nāga rājānam ṛcābhyām parisūtrakaiḥ san niruddhya āśu saṃsthāpya balim dadyāḥ dvidhānataḥ pūrva bhāge puṣkariṇyām harita ābham sa vajrakam halagrahīta maṃtreṇa nyasya lāja āhutim kule manaḥśilām pravālam ca agnim īḍa iti saṃpaṭhet vaiśvānareṇa mantreṇa paṭhat lāmja āhutim punar dadyāt ye te śata mantreṇa paścime kāṭikam nyaset śāli bījena sahitam kayā naḥ iti maṃtrakam varuṇasya iti maṃtreṇa dadyāt aṣṭādaśa āhutīḥ kuṃkumena samāyuktam kuvidaṃḍam ṛcā paṭhan vinyasya tena maṃtreṇa pradadyāt āhutim punar aiśānyām maṃdrakam raṃgamī śāvā iti saṃpaṭhan saṃsthāpya ājya āhutim dadyāt tam īśānaḥ ṛcā punar āsadyaiḥ maṃtra saṃyuktaiḥ devam nārāyaṇam yajet varuṇa ātmakam tatas dhyātvā tatas nīrājanam paṭhet jānubhyām avanim gatvā paṭhet jñāna amṛtam stavam dharmaḥ vaṃśam tatas kuryāt utsarga aṃte vidhīyate tatas devīm punar kṛtvā dattvā puṣpa añjali trayam utsṛṣṭam sarva sattvebhyaḥ dṛśyate jalam ūrjitam ramaṃtīm sarva bhūtāni snāna pāna avagāhanaiḥ varuṇam ca tatas devam puṣkariṇyām ca nikṣipet pakṣiṇaḥ ca śubhān tatra bhekam kūrmam ca kardamam śaivālam prakṣipet ca eva dakṣiṇām tad anantaram suvarṇam dhānya ratnam ca ācāryāya pṛthak dadet nityam samāpya vidhivat dadyāt pūrṇāhutim punar dadyāt arghyam ca sūryāya hastāsaḥ iti saṃjapan tatas pradakṣiṇa āvartam saṃveṣṭya kṣīra dhārayā prāsāda pakṣe prāsādam ārāme atha maṃḍapam śata adhidhārayā śaktyā tri vāram brāhmaṇaiḥ saha vikīrya lāja kusumam vrīhīḥ ca eva kapardakān yajamānaḥ sa patnīkaḥ praviśet sva gṛham punar tatas gṛha arcanam kṛtvā brāhmaṇān atha bhojayet kumārīḥ ca kumārān ca dīna andha kṛpaṇān api nārāyaṇam tatas dadyāt vipram uddiśya bhaktitaḥ viṣaya anukramaṇikā upavana ādi pratiṣṭhā varṇanam sūtaḥ uvāca ārāma ādau viśeṣaḥ yaḥ vakṣyate atra mayā adhunā aiśānyām kalaśe devam tatra nātham prapūjayet madhyame kalaśe pūjā grahāṇām ca tatas param sva dikṣu dvāra deśe tu paścima dvāra deśayoḥ brahmāṇam ca api anantam ca madhyatas varuṇam yajet varuṇam ca uda kumbha stham bhūta śākhāsu śobhanam tena ca āvāhayāmi tvām vibho svargāya vai bhava pūrva gam mandaram sthāpya toraṇa upari sattamāḥ dakṣiṇe kamalā tasya vāme puṣṭi vyavasthitiḥ saṃpūjya vidhivat bhaktyā viṣṇoḥ arāṭaḥ iti ṛcā dale saṃkarṣaṇa ādīn ca vimalā ādyāḥ ca nāyikāḥ saṃpūjya dhūpa dīpa ādyaiḥ upahāraiḥ anuttamaiḥ dhyāyet somam karṇikāyām dakṣiṇe padma saṃsthitam śukla ābham dvi bhujam śāntam keyūra ādi upaśobhitam praśasyam deva yakṣāṇām vara da abhaya hastakam imam devāḥ iti ṛcā upacāraiḥ pṛthagvidhaiḥ pūjayet ca niśānātham ghṛta bhaktam nivedayet indram jayantam ākāśam varuṇam ca agnim eva ca īśānam tatpuruṣam ca eva vāyum pūrva ādi dikṣu api karṇikāyāḥ vāma bhāge vara da abhaya hastakam dvi bhujam śukla varṇam ca mahādevam prapūjayet tryaṃbakeṇa ca maṃtreṇa dadyāt ca ghṛta piṣṭakam vāsudevāya devāya juhuyāt aṣṭau āhutīḥ paramānnena saumyasya juhuyāt aṣṭaviṃśatim gaṇeśasya tathā ājyena dadet eka āhutim budhaḥ brahmaṇaḥ varuṇasya atha ekaikām āhutim tathā grahāṇām sva ukta samidhā digīśānām pṛthak pṛthak ekaikām āhutim dadyāt ājyena ca yathākram karālī dhūmalī śvetā lohitā kanakaprabhā tāsām maṃtrāḥ krameṇa eva bindavaḥ yakāra sthāḥ ca vijñeyāḥ aṣṭa svara vibhūṣitāḥ ekaikām āhutim dadyāt dattvā ca eva samāhitaḥ agnīṣomam tathā indram ca pṛthivīm antarikṣakam sthālīpākena juhuyāt madhu kṣīra yava anvitam ekaikām āhutim teṣām samuddiśya pṛthak pṛthak japasva tvam mahābhāga śraddhayā ca eva vāgyataḥ maṅgalam paramānnam ca saura sūktam tathā japet tatas saṃmṛjya vidhinā snāpayitvā yathāvidhi yūpam garbhe vinikṣipya tatra kuryāt vicakṣaṇaḥ dhvajān āropya prāṃteṣu dadyāt somam vanaspatim ko adāt iti paṭhitvā ca vṛkṣāṇām karṇa vedhanam sūcyā su tīkṣṇayā kāryam dvi pātre vāma dakṣiṇe nava grahāṇām tṛpti artham yāvakam laḍḍukam tathā piṣṭakam ca pṛthak dadyāt kumārī bālakeṣu ca niśā raṃjita sūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya ca sa cūrṇakam pradadyāt dohakam ca eva vṛkṣāṇām vidhi pūrvakam prāśayet ca eva tān vṛkṣān imam mantram udāharet vṛkṣa agrāt patitasya api ārohāt patitasya ca maraṇe vā asthibhaṅge vā kartā pāpaiḥ na lipyate dhenum suvarṇam dhānyam ca ācāryāya pradakṣiṇam dattvā ca ṛtvije dadyāt suvarṇam rajatam tathā dhānyam ca brahmaṇe dadyāt ghṛta bhojyam sa śarkaram iṣṭām ca dakṣiṇām dadyāt sadasyāya tathā eva ca adhi kalaśam samānīya snānam kuryāt vidhānataḥ kṛtvā ca eva aniśam kuryāt dadyāt pūrṇāhutim tathā sarva oṣadhi udakam prokṣya tri vāram kṣīra dhārayā saṃveṣṭya tris catur vāram brahmaghoṣa puraḥsaram taṃtau viśeṣam vakṣyāmi varāḥ eva idam iti ṛcā vāsudevam dhanādhyakṣam tatas nārāyaṇam yajet evam saṃpūjya vidhinā dakṣiṇe pṛthivīm yajet śuddha kāṃñcana varṇa ābhām vara abhaya karām śubhām maṃḍūka sthām ca dvi bhujām sarva alaṅkāra sundarīm pāyasam madhu saṃyuktam balim dadyāt sa śarkaram vāmatas viśvakarmāṇam śuddha sphaṭika saṃnibham śūla ṭaṃka dharam śāṃtam saṃyajet upacārakaiḥ viśvan iti ṛcā tam ca balim ca madhu piṣṭakam dadyāt japet ca kauṣmāṇḍam sūktam pauruṣam eva ca ekaikam homayet paścāt pṛthivī homa karmaṇi picchile patitānām ca ucchritena aṃga saṃgataḥ ye ca atra prāṇinaḥ saṃti rakṣām kurvati setavaḥ gartam kṛtvā pañcaratnam saṃsthāpyam tad anantaram saṃsthāpya ca tatas yūpam saṃpūjya ca yathāvidhi ācāryāya tatas dadyāt iṣṭām ca vara dakṣiṇām poṭikām ca tatas śayyām dadyāt iṣṭa artha siddhaye setau vṛkṣa sthitāḥ ye syuḥ ropayet kadalīm śubhām teṣām pārśva dvaye pi evam ārāme ca pṛthak pṛthak go pracāra vaiśiṣṭya varṇanam sūtaḥ uvāca go pracāram punar vakṣye viśeṣam tatra me śṛṇu upacāraiḥ ca brahmāṇam rudram ca eva karālikām varāham soma sūrye ca mahādevam yathākramam homam ca eva yathā viṣṇoḥ kamalāyāḥ trayam trayam ājyena kṣetrapālānām anyeṣām madhu miśritaiḥ ekaikām āhutim dadyāt lāja ādiṣu pṛthak pṛthak samutsṛjya vidhānena yūpam saṃsthāpya pūjayet tri hasta māttram racitam kuryāt nāga phaṇa anvitam lājā saṃyukta vidhinā viśveṣām iti sañjapan mayi gṛbhṇāmi iti sampūjya yūpam ca rudra daivatam saṃpūjya rudram pañcāṃgam dhānyam vastram ca dakṣiṇām ācāryāya tathā hotre anyeṣām iṣṭa dakṣiṇām go pracāre ca śaileyam yūpam hasta dvaya anvitam pañca śīrṣa anvitam kuryāt hasta mātram praropayet yūpam ca caitravṛkṣam ca kuṇḍalī maṭha pīṭhikām saṃspṛśya ācamya vai viprāḥ prāṇāyāmena śudhyati catur hasta pramāṇena śata kuṇḍena saṃmitam tad ardham ca kaniṣṭhena aṣṭaka aṣṭa adhikam bhavet śiva lokaḥ tathā gāvaḥ sarva deva su pūjitāḥ gobhyaḥ eṣā mayā bhūmiḥ sampradattā śubha arthinā yāvaṃti tṛṇa gulmāni saṃti bhūmau śubhāni ca pūrve sīmām nibadhnīyāt kṛtvā vṛkṣasya ropaṇam setum kṛtvā dakṣiṇatas paścima iṃgāra ropaṇam uttare khānayet kūpam tasya sīmām na laṃghayeta tatas sahasradhārām ca śasyena paripūritām na kuryāt agni digbhāge dakṣiṇām vā tatas śubhām kulāni pātayati āśu brahmahatyāḥ ca viṃdati yāvat tṛṇāni tad bhūmau sapta saṃkhyāni saṃkhyayā vṛṣotsargāḥ vasāne tu pradadyāt yaḥ mahīm dvijāḥ na yāti viprāḥ preta tvam tasmāt viprāt amatsarāḥ tatra mānam pṛthak ca eva śṛṇuta atra samāgatāḥ sīmā atīte na asti pātakam maṇḍapam pūjayet sūryam vāsudeva samanvitam homaḥ tila guḍābhyām ca aṣṭau aṣṭau pṛthak pṛthak yatna siddham tatas kṛtvā śulka ghaṭa catuṣṭayam samutsṛjet japet paścāt sauram sūktam ca vaiṣṇavam vaṭa patre tu saṃlikhya citram nirmāya vā punar dikpālān saṃnyaset svāsu svāsu dikṣu vicakṣaṇaḥ baddhāñjaliḥ paṭhet maṃtrān iṃdra ādīnām yathākramam bho vahne meṣa vāhaḥ tvam catur śṛṃga virājita anātham maṇḍapam tvam hi dharmataḥ trātum arhasi yama tvam dakṣiṇa āśā īśa mahā mahiṣa vāhana anātham maṇḍapam tvam hi dharmataḥ trātum arhasi mañca sthaḥ rākṣasa indraḥ tvam khaḍga pāṇiḥ mahā balaḥ anātham maṇḍapam tvam hi dharmataḥ trātum arhasi vāri rāj dhvaja hastaḥ asi pavanaḥ mṛga vāhanaḥ anātham maṇḍapam tvam hi dharmataḥ trātum arhasi anātham maṇḍapam tvam hi dharmataḥ trātum arhasi anātham maṇḍapam tvam hi dharmataḥ trātum arhasi anaṃtaḥ nāga rājaḥ yaḥ dharām uddhṛtya tiṣṭhati anātham maṇḍapam tvam hi dharmataḥ srātum arhasi caturṇām eva varṇānām sthiti artham mṛga pakṣiṇām prītaye vāsudevasya evam maṇḍapam utsṛjet bhagne stambhe tṛṇe jīrṇe punar tṛṇa pradāpane sthāpane ca tathā eva asya pratiṣṭhā syāt yathā akṣayā ghāta apāya ādi doṣeṇa mriyaṃte yadi jantavaḥ pratiṣṭhāyām kṛtāyām tu dharmaḥ me syāt na pātakam mānuṣāḥ paśavaḥ ye ca nivasanti iha maṇḍape svasti ca astu sadā teṣām tvad prasādāt kila prabho tatas triguṇa sūtreṇa su trāmāṇā iti vai ṛcā saptadhā veṣṭayitvā tu dakṣiṇām saṃprakāśya ca maṇḍape bhojayet viprān teṣām dadyāt yathā īpsitān dīnebhyaḥ ca pṛthak dadyāt gṛham vipra puraḥsaram praviśet tūrya ghoṣeṇa prakuryāt ca gṛha arcanam evam prapāyām vijñeyaḥ viśeṣaḥ varuṇam vrajet vāsudevena sahitam sa aṃga upāṃgam sa dakṣiṇam sthālīpāka vidhānena prakuryāt deśika uttamaḥ ācāryāya gṛham dadyāt pariccheda samanvitam ṛtvije tāmra pātram ca jala pūrṇam ca dhānyakam dikpālān dvāra deśe tu kūpa yāge viśeṣataḥ brahmāṇam nāga rājānam dvārapālau ca paścime bali dānam vidhānena kṛtvā dadyāt yathāvidhi vajrī ca dhūmalī kṛṣṇā pītā ca eva atha vāruṇī śīghrā gaurī umā ca eva pītā śuklā prakīrtitā kuṃbheṣu pūjayet devān maheśam prathamam budhaḥ dakṣiṇe kalaśe viṣṇum karṇikāyām jaleśvaram saṃpūjya vaṭa patre ca nāgān saṃlikhya nāga jaiḥ yaḥ nāgāḥ tān pravakṣyāmi anaṃtaḥ vāsukiḥ tathā puṃḍarīka dala ābhāsa śubha karṇa aṃta locana phaṇā sahasra saṃyukta śaṃkha abja kṛta locana sarva nāgasya śūrasya kṛta svastika lāṃchana śaṃkhapālaḥ iti khyāta jalādhāra pratīkṣaka ati pīta suvarṇa ābha candra ardha aṃkita mastaka paṃcabiṃdu kṛta ābhogaḥ grīvāyām eka śekharaḥ sarve te prīta manasaḥ pūjām gṛhṇaṃtu me sadā ājyam saṃskṛtya juhuyāt digīśānām yathākramam āditya ādi grahān ca eva brahmāṇam kṛṣṇam eva ca madhu piṣṭena ca śivam varuṇam juhuyāt tatas prādeśa mātram saṃprokṣya yūpam ca asya pramāṇakam catur asram śūla yuktam gaṇān ānīya pūjayet kūpe nikṣipya tān nāgān pañcaratnam kṣipet tatas su trāmāṇā iti maṃtreṇa tridhā saṃveṣṭya sūtrakaiḥ rañjitaḥ kadalī vṛkṣam varuṇāya samutsṛjet trātāram iti maṃtreṇa vastra mālyena bhūṣayet karṇa vedham tatas kṛtvā utsṛjet vākyam uccaran om adya ityādi sarva bhūtebhyaḥ phala puṣpa patra chāyā āvṛta mukhya nānā taru viracitam ārāmam vanaspati devatam su pūjitam vedavyāsa ādi ukta phala avāptaye amuka ṛṣi sagotraḥ amuka deva śarma aham utsṛje mahā utsavam tatas kuryāt kṛtvā baddhāñjaliḥ paṭhet vṛkṣa agrāt patitasya api ārohāt patitasya vā maraṇe ca asthi bhaṃge vā kartā pāpaiḥ na lipyate vajra āghāta ādi doṣeṇa mriyaṃte taravaḥ yadā tad dośamana arthāya tasya api etat pratiṣṭhitam madhye yūpam samāropya yatnataḥ madhu lāja akṣatam dadyāt añjanam mālyam eva ca niśā sūtreṇa saṃveṣṭya kadalī viṭapam nyaset veṣṭayet kṣīra dhārām ca pātayet ghṛta dhārayā toya anvitam guccha yuktam veṣṭayet sva gṛham vrajet kṣudra ārāma pratiṣṭhā varṇanam sūtaḥ uvāca kṣudra ārāma pratiṣṭhām ca vakṣye vai dvijasattamāḥ sthāpayet kalaśam tatra viṣṇum somam samarcayet ācārya mātram varayet niśā sūtraiḥ praveṣṭayet vṛkṣān mālyaiḥ alaṃkṛtya bhūṣayet bhūṣaṇa ādinā karṇa vedham tatas kṛtvā utsṛjet vākya pūrvakam dadyāt yūpam madhya deśe ropayet kadalīm tatas raṃbhāḥ ca ropayet dikṣu sthālīpāka vidhānataḥ aṣṭau aṣṭau ca juhuyāt anyeṣām ca ghṛtena tu ekaikām āhutim dadyāt sviṣṭakṛt tad anantaram dakṣiṇām ca tatas dadyāt pūrṇām dattvā āhutim vrajet eka ādi vṛkṣam vṛkṣāṇām vidhim vakṣye dvijottamāḥ vṛkṣa mūle yajet dharmam pṛthivī ca viśam tathā digīśān ca tathā yakṣān ācāryam toṣayet tatas dhenum ca dakṣiṇām dadyāt dohadam vṛkṣa pūjanam kṣudra ārāma pratiṣṭhā varṇanam sūtaḥ uvāca atha aśvattha pratiṣṭhāyām mūle bāhu pramāṇake sthaṃḍilam kārayet tatra caṃdanena ukṣitam tathā pūrvedyu rātri samaye tat viṣṇoḥ iti vai ṛcā sthāpayet vāriṇā pūrṇam kayā nā iti ca gandhakam dadyāt dūrvā akṣatam kalpe brāhmaṇa traya bhojanam kārayet sita sūtraiḥ ca veṣṭayet candana ukṣitaiḥ kuṃbhe vināyakam pūjya brahmāṇam ca pare ghaṭam sva dikṣu dikpatīn ca eva vṛkṣa mūle nava grahān maṃḍale śivam abhyarcya pīṭha pūjā puraḥsaram atha dhyānam pravakṣyāmi śvetam vṛṣabham eva ca dvi bhujam śūla hastam ca sarva ābharaṇa saṃyutam āropayet sva sāmarthyāt bhūtaśuddhim samācaret tatas arghya pātram kṛtvā tu pīṭha pūjām samācaret gaṇeśam guru pādam ca jayam bhadram samāhitaḥ candra sūrya agnika ādīnām maṃḍalāni kramāt yajet punar pātra aṃtara stham ca gṛhītvā kusumam budhaḥ pāṇikacchapikām kṛtvā dhyāyet vai varuṇam tathā madhuparkam ca āsanam ca pṛcchet ca svāgatam punar mudrām pradarśya vidhivat aṃga pūjām samācaret pūrva ādi patre indra ādīn brahmāṇam madhyatas yajet anaṃtam puratas ca eva teṣām astrāṇi tad bahis madhye toya adhipam rudram śāṃtam ca eva praśāṃtakam kāmam dharmam adharmam ca dikṣu nārā yaṇam śivam nairṛte ca yajet durgām pārśvayoḥ ca śatakratum vināyakam ca viṣṇum ca gaṅgām pṛthivi ṣaṣṭikam ṣoḍaśena upacāreṇa pūjayet ca viśeṣataḥ maṃḍalasya uttare bhāge nāga rūpam anaṃtakam paṃca kṛṣṇālakaiḥ kuryāt bṛhat parva pramāṇakam āropayet ca akṣata ādyaiḥ śveta candana puṣpakaiḥ varuṇam juhuyāt pūrvam madhunā pāyasena vā tila akṣataiḥ vā ājyaiḥ vā trimadhu aktaiḥ atha api vā aṣṭottaraśatam kuryāt digīśānām ghṛtena tu ekaikām āhutim dadyāt puṣpaiḥ tila ghṛtena ca nārāyaṇam śivam durgām gaṇeśam ca grahān niśi aṣṭau aṣṭau ca juhuyāt ghṛtaiḥ eka āhutiḥ bhaveta brahmā ayudhvānam iti maṃtreṇa brahmāṇam pāyasena tu eka āhutim tatas dadyāt āpohiṣṭhā iti vā tribhiḥ imam varuṇaḥ iti vā ṛcā punar vātasya yam iti punar pañca varṇam yathākramāt tatas sviṣṭakṛte dadyāt balim dadyāt anukramāt madhu ājya pāyasam dadyāt varuṇāya viśeṣataḥ yava kṣīram digīśebhyaḥ hi anyebhyaḥ pāyasena tu nāgāya piṣṭakam dadyāt lājā homa aṣṭakam punar aṣṭa aṣṭāpada mānena varuṇam rājatena tu kuryāt pūrva dvayena api bāṇa ratti suvarṇakaiḥ kuryāt puṣkariṇīm tatra pūrva ardhe caturasrake varuṇam vinyaset tatra tathā puṣkariṇīm api om adya ityādi viṣṇu rūpāya karuṇāya śruti rati ādi ukta vedavyāsa sapraṇīta agniṣṭoma phala prāptaye puṣkariṇī pratiṣṭhā karmaṇi imām puṣkariṇīm suvarṇa rājatām sva gṛhya uditām sa alaṃkārām su pūjitām amuka gotraḥ amuka deva śarmā tubhyam aham saṃpradade iti utsarga vākyam om adya ityādi brāhmaṇa mukhyebhyaḥ mama agniṣṭoma ādi aneka phala prāptaye imam jalāśayam varuṇa daivatam su pūjitam caturmukha sahitam catur sattva avac pūrva avasthāyinīm yaṣṭim samāropya vidhānataḥ puṣkariṇyā samam tena nāga yaṣṭi aṃtare kṣipet tatra eva ananta nāgam ca maṃtram etat udīrayet puṃḍarīka dala ābhāsa śubha rakta aṃta locana dakṣiṇām ca tatas dadyāt tatas pūrṇām vidhāya ca mocayet makarān grāhān mīna kūrmān jalecarān puṣkariṇyām ca tris kuryāt khātam sarva pradakṣiṇām āditya adhyāyakam japtvā kṣipet lāja kapardakān sūtreṇa veṣṭayet prājñaḥ raktena ca catuṣkramāt pathi saṃtoṣayet dīnān saṃtoṣya ca gṛham vrajet sarovara ādi pratiṣṭhā vidhāna varṇanam sūtaḥ uvāca nalinyāḥ ca tathā vāpyāḥ hradasya dvijasattamāḥ vidhim vakṣye saha aṅgena vidhānam śṛṇuta dvijāḥ āpohiṣṭhā iti mantreṇa tathā astraiḥ śataiḥ api sva maṇḍale śubhe sthāne viśet pūrva mukhena tu gaṇeśam varuṇam ca eva ghaṭe saṃpūjayet śivam vāgīśam ca tathā viṣṇum sūrye kuṃbhe samarcayet pāyasena āhutim dadyāt varuṇāya ghṛtena ca ekaikām āhutim dadyāt anyeṣām ca sruveṇa ca yūpam niveśayet paścāt dadyāt dhenum ca dakṣiṇām pūrṇam dadyāt savitre arghyam dattvā tu sva gṛham vrajet ārāmasya vidhim vakṣye pratiṣṭhā vidhi vistaram hīnārāmasya ca tathā eka vṛkṣasya ca dvijāḥ araṇya madhye pāścātye uttare vā viśeṣataḥ maṃḍapam vartulam kuryāt arghya hasta pramāṇakam tad dakṣiṇe bhavet kuṃḍam catur asram samam śubham maṃdara ādikam āvāhya tatas saṃpūjayet kramāt bhṛgum karṇa samārūḍham sarva bhūṣaṇa bhūṣitam viṣvaksenasya maṃtraḥ yam pūjāyām ca eva sarvatas dvārapālam ca saṃpūrṇam gaurī ādīn kalaśeṣu ca svāsu dikṣu digīśānām bali puṣpa akṣata ādi nā vedi pārśve tatas gatvā vedim āvāhya pūjayet āsanam kalpayitvā tu sāmānya arghyam vidhāya ca aiśāne kalaśe vidyut brahmāṇam ca tathā grahān maḍala īśam vāsudevam sa āsanam ca bṛhaspatim dhyātvā āropayet evam bāla ādīn atha nāyakān vimalā ādyāḥ nāyikāḥ ca digīśān ca yathāvidhi ṣoḍaśa uccais pṛthak rūpaiḥ prati puṣpa aṃjali kramāt paritas pūjayet viṣṇum śivam durgām sarasvatīm aśva ārūḍham divya rūpam padma akṣam dhṛta puṣpakam śvetam vanaspatim dhyāyet dvi bhujam pīta vāsasam sva ratha stham mahā bāhum śaṃkha aṃkuśa sa kheṭakam daśa svara anvitam toyam svabhāvam tamasā anvitam maṃtraḥ ayam devadevasya pūjāyām viniyojayet nīlam jayam bhṛṃgiṇam ca paritas ca yathākramāt tatas kuśa kaṃḍikām kṛtvā sthālīpākam vidhānataḥ aṣṭottaraśatam ca eva somāya dvādaśa āhutīḥ vānaspateḥ tathā aṣṭau ca ājye anyeṣām vidhīyatām ekaikām āhutim dadyāt sapta jihvām anantaram vāstoṣpataye iti maṃtreṇa sthālīpāka dvayam nayet vṛkṣa ādīn sthāpayet pūrve gāyatryā prathamam budhaḥ abjaiḥ agram kāṃsya vastram ratnam dikṣu yathākramam brīhayaḥ ca iti maṃtreṇa tathā ca saritaḥ ca me mitra trayaḥ ca iti tathā pūṣā ca me ṛcā tathā saṃsthāpya vrīhīn saṃvāpya tatra eva vidhi pūrvakam saṃsthāpya yajamānam ca surāḥ tvām iti mantrakaiḥ ācāryam ātmane tatra saṃsthitam dvija puṃgavaiḥ samāpya nitya vidhinā ācāryāya atha ca dakṣiṇām dhenum ca loha pātram ca dattvā iṣṭām ca dakṣiṇām brāhmaṇebhyaḥ yathāśakti dadyāt pūrṇām gṛham vrajet kṣudra ārāma pratiṣṭhā varṇanam sūtaḥ uvāca kṣudra ārāma pratiṣṭhām ca vakṣye ca dvijasattama amaṃḍale śubhe sthāne sthāpayet kalaśam tatra somam viṣṇum samarcayet ācārya mātram varayet niśā sūtraiḥ praveṣṭayet vṛkṣān mālyaiḥ alaṃkṛtya bhūṣayet bhūṣaṇa ādinā bhojayet paṃca viprān ca viśeṣataḥ karṇavedham tatas kṛtvā utsṛjet vā āsya pūrvakam dadyāt yūpam madhya deśe ropayet kadalīm tatas raṃbhām ca ropayet dikṣu sthālīpāka vidhānataḥ aṣṭau aṣṭau ca juhuyāt anyeṣām ca ghṛtena tu ekaikām āhutim dadyāt sviṣṭakṛt tad anantaram dakṣiṇām ca tatas dadyāt pūrṇām dadyāt gṛham vrajet śreṣṭha vṛkṣa pratiṣṭhā vidhāna varṇanam sūtaḥ uvāca eka ādi varavṛkṣāṇām vidhim vakṣye dvijottamāḥ vṛkṣasya paścime bhāge sthāpayet kalaśam tatas vṛkṣam saṃsthāpayet pūrvam sūtreṇa pariveṣṭayet brahmāṇam kalaśebhyaḥ ca somam viṣṇum vanaspatim vṛkṣa mūle yajet dharmam pṛthivīm ca viśam tathā digīśān ca tathā yakṣān na ācāryam toṣayet tatas dhenum ca dakṣiṇām dadyāt dohadam vṛkṣa pūjanam sūtaḥ uvāca atha aśvattha pratiṣṭhāyām mūle bāhu pramāṇakam sthaṇḍilam kārayet tatra caṃdanena aṅkitam yathā pūrvedyu rātri samaye tat viṣṇoḥ iti vai ṛcā sthāpayet vāriṇā pūrṇam kayā nā iti ca gaṃdhakam gaṃdha dvāra iti tailena śrīḥ ca tā iti ca caṃdanam dadyāt dūrvā akṣatam kalye brāhmaṇa traya bhojanam kārayet sita sūtraiḥ ca veṣṭayet caṃdanasya ca kumbhe vināyakam pūjya brahmāṇam ca pare ghaṭe sva dikṣu dikpatīn ca api vṛkṣa mūle nava grahān maṃḍale śivam abhyarcyam pīṭha pūjā puraḥsaram pūrve caṃḍam pracaṃḍam ca dakṣiṇe naṃdi bhṛṃgiṇau anaṃtam paścime kāmam uttare gaṇanāyakam kārtikeyam madhyadeśe ādhāra śakti pūrvakam anaṃtam pṛthivīm ca eva trivṛt tam ca tri maṃḍalam atha dhyānam pravakṣyāmi śvetam vṛṣabham eva ca dvi bhujam śūla hastam ca sarva ābharaṇa saṃyutam āropayet svataṃtreṇa mūle viṣṇum samarcayet śaṃkaram ca tathā madhye agre brahmāṇakam yajet balim ca piṣṭaka annam ca dattvā ca śrapayet carum anyeṣām ca sruveṇa eva homam dadyāt prayatnataḥ ropayet kadalī vṛkṣam ācāryam paritoṣayet kṛtvā pūrṇām paṃca dhārām kṛtvā ca api pradakṣiṇām kṣīra dhārām ca saṃpādya arghyam dattvā gṛham vrajet vaṭa pratiṣṭhā vidhāna varṇanam sūtaḥ uvāca vaṭa sthānam atho vakṣye tasya mūle tu dakṣiṇe gaṇeśam ca śivam viṣṇum pūjayitvā hunet carum yava kṣīra balim dadyāt utsṛjet vākyam uccaran yūpam āropayet paścāt vaṭa mūlaiḥ samarpayet yakṣān nāgān ca gaṃdharvān siddhān ca eva marut gaṇān bilva pratiṣṭhā vidhāna varṇanam sūtaḥ uvāca vakṣye bilva pratiṣṭhām ca pūrvedyus adhivāsayet tryaṃbakam ca iti maṃtreṇa sthāpayet gandha vāriṇā sunābha iti ca maṃtreṇa me gṛhṇāmi iti ca akṣatam tatas dhūpam vastram mālyam nivedayet niśā raktena vā kuryāt aṣṭa patram su śobhanam niveṣṭanam tatas kuryāt vṛkṣasya dvijasattamāḥ vrīhīn ca vāpayet tatra uttara abhimukhaḥ tathā śivam viṣṇum ca brahmāṇam pūjayet bhūtim icchatā śivam ca nāyakam kuryāt ādityān patra mūlake śeṣam ca taru mūle tu madhye anaṃtam śatakratum vanapālam ca somam ca sūryam pṛdhvīm anukramāt homaḥ tila akṣataiḥ kāryaḥ balim dadyāt ghṛta odanaiḥ yakṣebhyaḥ māṣa bhaktam ca vāyanāni ca dvādaśa grahāṇām prītaye dadyāt kṣīreṇa āveṣṭya dakṣiṇām kāṃcanam kāṃsya pātram ca tāṃbūlam tāmra pātrakam atha rātri pratiṣṭhām ca vakṣye śāstra anusārataḥ yakṣa eka vṛkṣa saṃskāre na punar jāyate bhuvi pūrvedyus upavāhe tu vṛkṣa mūle ghaṭam nyaset viṣṇum śivam gaṇeśam ca pūjayitvā tu sthāpayet kalaśān pañca vā sapta gaṃdha tailaiḥ alaṃkṛtān sūtraiḥ saṃveṣṭanam kṛtvā vastra mālyaiḥ anaṃtaram kāṃḍāt iti ca maṃtreṇa dadyāt dūrvā kṣatam tatas viṣṇusūktena ca punar siṃdūra aṃjana caṃdanam hunet paṃca āhutīḥ tatra yūpam dadyāt samutsṛjet veṣṭayet kṣīra toyena dhānyam dhenum ca dakṣiṇām dadyāt arghyam hunet pūrṇam bhojayet dvija daṃpatī sūtaḥ uvāca śata hasta mitām muṣṭim nānā taru vibhūṣitām pūga āmra ādi phalaiḥ yuktam vāstum kṛtvā yajet tu yaḥ agni kāryam tatas kṛtvā dadyāt viprāya dakṣiṇām maṇḍapa pratiṣṭhā vidhāna varṇanam sūtaḥ uvāca pratiṣṭhām maṃḍapasya eva śailadāru mayasya ca tṛṇa kāṣṭhasya ca vibho tṛṇa vat tasya ca dvijāḥ sūryam somam tathā viṣṇum kalaśe tu samarcayet prokṣayet kuśa toyena āpohiṣṭhā iti vai ṛcā ākṛṣṇena iti tailena śrīḥ ca te iti caṃdanam siṃdūra alaktakam dadyāt añjanam pūrvayā saha dikpālān ca eva vinyasya maṃḍape śubha lakṣaṇe sūryam āvāhayet tatra somam viṣṇum ca pārśvayoḥ gaṇeśam ca grahān ca eva dikpālān ca ghaṭe arcayet ādityasya tathā viṣṇoḥ somasya dvādaśa āhutīḥ balim ca pāyasam dadyāt tailam kṣīram atha api vā tatas śveta ghaṭam dadyāt maṇḍapa upari sattamāḥ triguṇena niśā aktaiḥ vā veṣṭayet vāri dhārayā dakṣiṇām vidhivat dadyāt sūryāya arghyam nivedayet tṛṇa veśmani vai sūryam vāsudeva samanvitam ghaṭe gaṇeśam vara dam varam kṛtvā samutsṛjet aiśānyām dāpayet yūpam dhvajān dikṣu prakalpayet prapāyām varuṇaḥ pūjyaḥ viśvakarmā prayatnataḥ pṛthivīm ca gaṇeśam ca pūjayitvā hunet ghṛtam mahā yūpa nirmāṇa pratiṣṭhā varṇanam sūtaḥ uvāca catur hastam mahā yūpam hasta ṣoḍaśa nirmitam vakṣye tam ca pratiṣṭhām ca rātrau trairātrikam yajet varuṇam sita kuṃbhe ca prapā kūpasya paścime gāyatryā snāpayet pūrva mā apohiṣṭhā iti vai kramāt gaṃdha dvāra iti gandham ca aṃśunā ca iti tailakam ādau śrāddham na kartavyam pratiṣṭhā ante vidhīyate daṃpatī bhojanam kuryāt varayet eka brāhmaṇam maṃḍape ca aṣṭa haste ca kalaśam tatra vinyaset pūjayet varuṇam devam nārāyaṇa samanvitam śivam ca pṛthivīm ca eva svaiḥ svaiḥ mantraiḥ yathākramāt tatas kuśa kaṃḍikām kṛtvā sthālīpāka vidhānataḥ varuṇam ca samabhyarcya juhuyāt āhutīḥ daśa anyeṣām ca sruveṇa eva dadyāt eka āhutim kramāt varuṇasya ukta varuṇam tat tvā yāmi tatas param varuṇasya uttaṃbhanam asi iti ca ābhyām devān tathā eva ca yena a pāvaka cakṣasā paṃcamam samudāhṛtam tatas sviṣṭakṛtam kṛtvā saptajihvam pratiṣṭhām vidhivat caret yajamānaḥ śuddha dine ekādaśyām atha api vā nārāyaṇam śivam somam brahmāṇam ca indram eva ca tvām gaṃdharva iti ca punar puṣpam maṃḍa īśana iti ca māna stoka iti kusumam ca caṃdanam vaiśvadevī iti ca punar maṃtreṇa anena caṃdanam dūrvā maṃtreṇa dūrvāḥ ca rūpeṇa iti ca darppaṇam sa kuśaiḥ pītasūtra ādyaiḥ veṣṭayet kṣīra dhārayā śatadhārā jalena eva veṣṭayet sva gṛham vrajet vastreṇa āvṛtya vidhivat budhaḥ kāle ghaṭam nyaset sapta paṃca tribhiḥ vā atha tat viṣṇoḥ iti vai ṛcā snāpayet atha sādhvībhiḥ kṛta maṃgala pūrvakam tatas śrāddham samāpya eva mātṛ pūjā grahān loka īśvarān madhye ādityān ca marut gaṇān rudrān vasūn ca kalaśe paritas ca samarcayet tatas kuśa kaṃḍikām kṛtvā homam tila yavena tu aṣṭottaraśatam kuryāt anyeṣām śaktitas hunet nārāyaṇam samuddiśya dadyāt utsṛjya sattamāḥ madhye yūpam samuddiśya caru pākam balim dadet dakṣiṇām kāṃcanam dadyāt tilam dhānyam sa puṣpakam dhenum payasvinīm dadyāt veṣṭayet kṣīra dhārayā jayantyāḥ somavṛkṣasya tathā somavaṭasya ca pāṭalā kanakasya eva śālmalī niṃbakasya ca biṃba aśoka vaṭasya eva pratiṣṭhām na eva kārayet bhadrakasya śamīkoṇa caṃḍātaka bakasya ca sūtaḥ uvāca vṛkṣa ādīnām pratiṣṭhām ca uttameṣu uttamam caret madhye madhye kaniṣṭhā tu kaniṣṭham parikīrtitam vartulam maṃḍalam kuryāt tat tu śīrṣe tathā antyake madhye vā vedikām kuryāt tad madhye kuṃḍa maṃḍalam pūrvedyus rātri samaye ghaṭam saṃsthāpya pūjayet śeṣam saṃpūjya vidhivat pṛthivīm ca śivam tathā gaṃdha toyena gāyatryā setum saṃpūjya mokṣayet ca mantreṇa āpyāyasva iti vai ṛcā dadyāt gandha ādikam śrīḥ ca te ācāryam eva ca setu yāge vidhātavyam tathā dhānyācale pi ca yajet enam kṛte mauli yāga artham yāga maṃḍapam vedim āvāhayet pūrvam maṃḍapam pratipūjayet sthaṃḍile sarvatobhadre śeṣam viṣṇum pradarśayet sthālīpākena juhuyāt aṣṭāviṃśatika trayam balim dadyāt pṛthagrūpam śeṣayet vidhi pūrvakam piṣṭaka annam ghṛta annam ca vistare vā guḍa odanam māṣa bhaktam tu lokāya pṛthivyai paramānnakam vākya pūrvam sṛjet dhīraḥ vākya prakaraṇam śṛṇu baddhāṃñjaliḥ paṭhet mantram kuryāt ca vidhivat tatas picchile patitānām ca udgatena aṅga bhaṅgataḥ ye ca atra prāṇinaḥ santi sarveṣām prāṇa dhārakāḥ yūpam dadyāt iti mantreṇa ante ca api tathā dhvajān vidhivat dakṣiṇām dadyāt kulāni nava pañca vā pūrṇām dattvā savitre arghyam dattvā ca sva gṛham vrajet an ātape kṣudrasetoḥ pratiṣṭhām vidhivat caret viṣṇum śivam hutāśam ca eka kuṇḍe samarcayet kuryāt ekaikaśas viprāḥ aṣṭā viṃśati saṃkhyayā utsṛjya dāpayet dhūpam dhvaja varjyam hi sattamāḥ jñātibhiḥ saha bhuñjīta kṛtakṛtyaḥ abhidhīyate sūtaḥ uvāca ṣaṣṭi hasta mitām bhūmim tasya pūrṇām manoramām pracāra artham gavām ca eva yaḥ dadyāt su samāhitaḥ yaḥ dadyāt kevalām bhūmim kanyām dāsīm tathā vṛṣam alaṃkāram vinā dhenum phalasya ardham prakīrtitam amaṇḍape śubhe sthāne śarkarā ādi vivarjite tatra saṃpūjayet bhadram brahmāṇam ca śacīpatim gaṇeśam kṣetrapālam ca śeṣam ca eva digīśvarān pañca upacāraiḥ vidhivat pūjayet pāyasa ādinā tryambakena eva maṃtreṇa bhūmim saṃsthāpya pūjayet pañcagavyena ca punar ca puṣpakam evam yūpasya ca tathā adhigṛhṇāti maṃtrakam sura asura iti kusumam dūrvā mantreṇa dūrvikām sthālīpākena vidhinā anyeṣām pūrvavat caret utsṛjya āropayet dīpam sthiraḥ bhava iti vai ṛcā pṛthivīm ca varāham ca kūrma mādhava śaktikān vāstoṣpatim ca viṣṇum ca yūpe saṃpūjayet kramāt yāvaṃti tṛṇa gulmāni saṃti bhūmau śubhāni ca sūtaḥ uvāca śarad kāle vyatīte tu vasaṃte yajñam ārabhet nārāyaṇa ādi mūrtīnām dvātriṃśat bhedaḥ eva tu pratiṣṭhām pratimānām ca gajāsya ādīn ca sattamāḥ gaṇeśa graha dikpālān prati kuṃbheṣu pūjayet sthaṃḍile pūjayet viṣṇum parivāra gaṇam yajet pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ paṃcamṛd piṇḍakaiḥ api tulasī kusumā puṣpa patrāṇi āhuḥ tripatrakam mṛttikā kari daṃtasya tathā aśva khura mṛttikā kuryāt prāṇa pratiṣṭhām ca homam kuryāt yathāvidhi dakṣiṇām vidhivat dadyāt pūrṇām tu tad anantaram sūtaḥ uvāca atas param tu vipra indrāḥ kālī ādīnām tathā eva ca pañcāmṛtaiḥ pañcagavyaiḥ karīṣa śata dhārayā śrī bilve pūjayet devīm dadyāt prāṇam anaṃtaram bilva patraiḥ phalaiḥ vā api dadyāt ca api śata āhutīḥ ekaikaśas tu sarveṣām dadyāt kāñcana dakṣiṇām pratimām kālikāyāḥ ca tārāyāḥ ca pṛthak pṛthak grāhyam vinā arcayet viprāḥ pañca pañcaśataiḥ api samīraṇam tatas dadyāt peṭikāyām niveśayet tatas vai ca aṣṭama dine rātrau api prapūjayet paśu dānam prakartavyam agni kāryam ca pāyasaiḥ śiva liṅga pratiṣṭhām ca vakṣye taṃtra matam yathā tri vipram bhojayet viprāḥ adhivāsyam viśeṣataḥ ācāryam varayet prātar snāpayet pūrva vartmanā dadyāt samīraṇam paścāt agni kāryam samācaret tila hema mayīm gām ca dadyāt gām ca vidhānataḥ pūrṇimāyām viśeṣeṇa na anyeṣām ca kathaṃcana homa aṃte vasudhārām ca kuṃbhe dattvā vidhānataḥ śālaśamaśilāyāḥ ca pratiṣṭhām vidhivat caret sadyas adhivāsayet devam dvādaśyām snāpayet atha kuṃbhe prajāpatim sthāpya śveta abjam nava nābhake cakra svarūpataḥ jñeyam pradadyāt ca samīraṇam ānīya tāmra bhāṃḍe ca tri kālam pratipūjayet sa kāñcanam vastra yugmam prada dyāt bhūri dakṣiṇam śrī sūryasya gaṇeśasya viriñceḥ ca api sattamāḥ vaṭa vṛkṣa aṃtikam gatvā sthāpayet varuṇam tatas aṣṭāviṃśatibhiḥ ddattvā dadyāt prāṇam anantaram eka aham athavā ākāśe guptam kṛtvā udakaiḥ kumārīm bhojayet rātrau dadyāt kāñcana dakṣiṇām pratimām bhuvaneśīm ca mahāmāyā ambikām api kāmākṣīm ca tatas devīm indrākṣīm ca aparājitām pūrvedyus rātri samaye piṣṭa kāṣṭau nivedayet aṣṭau nirmāṇayet paścāt balim ca aṣṭau vidhāna vid parivāra gaṇaiḥ sārddham pūjayet prayataḥ sudhīḥ samīraṇam tatas dadyāt śivam sūryam yajet punar pāyasa annaiḥ ca juhuyāt tri dinam lipi pūjanam kumārī pūjanam kuryāt agnikāryam dina trayam paśu dānam ca kartavyam vibhave sati sattamāḥ sūtaḥ uvāca yasya ye graha doṣāḥ syuḥ teṣām śāṃtim yathākramāt graha ṛkṣa ādyaiḥ kṛtam divyam āntarikṣam nibodha me bhaumam ca alpa phalam jñeyam divya āntarikṣam eva ca sapta aham aphalam dadyāt daivam ca api ca tad kṣaṇāt devānām hasanam ca eva kalkanam rudhira sravaḥ sarpa ādi ārohaṇam ca eva daivam tat api dhārayiṣyati darśanam dhūmaketoḥ ca nakṣatre dhūma darśanam rājñaḥ janma dine vā atha śakracāpam dina aṃtare ākāśe api atha bhūmau ca tatra maṇḍūkam eva ca haridrā vṛṣṭiḥ pāṣāṇe siṃha bilva ākṛtiḥ yadi darśane rāṣṭra durbhikṣa makaram nṛpati kṣayaḥ ākṛṣṇena iti mantreṇa atha vā arkeṇa yatnataḥ dhānya sāram gavām sāram kūpe kumbha pradarśanam ādityasya adbhutam vidyāt kamalam juhuyāt tatas sahasram juhuyāt vā atha tatas śāṃtiḥ bhavet dhruvam vikṛtāḥ pakṣiṇaḥ ca eva pāṃḍu kapotakāḥ tatas śvetolūkaḥ bṛhan ca eva droṇakākaḥ ca kokilaḥ sthūla bhaṅga pragrahaṇam prarohaṇam atha api vā hārāḥ kaṭakaṭāyaṃte jātasya daṃta sambhavaḥ hasatā devatānām ca gātre svedaḥ ca jāyate nimittāni evamādīni jāyaṃte yasya veśmani ṣaḍbhiḥ māsaiḥ ca mriyate gṛhiṇī ca śubhā ca yā kuryāt ādityavāre vā ayutam tila pāyasam tatas śāṃtiḥ bhavet āśu dhenum dadyāt ca dakṣiṇām pāyasam tila mudgau ca puṣpam vā tālavṛntakam ikṣu modaka piṇyākān juhuyāt ravim uddiśan siṃhāsanam ratha chatram dhvajaḥ cāmara bhūṣite akasmāt dṛśyate yatra rājñaḥ vā anyatra kutracid āgamasya ca dṛṣṭvā eva bhaṃgaḥ kaṭakaṭāyanam cala tvam ca adharasya api tathā kaṭakaṭāyanam rāja amātya vināśāya mahīm ca tad sutaḥ api vā hastinaḥ mada yuktāḥ ca mriyaṃte na atra saṃśayaḥ tāḍī pūga ādayaḥ yatra yamau syātām pramādataḥ gehī tatra vinaśyeta sa dāraḥ putra saṃyutaḥ baddha puṣpe yadā puṣpam phalam vā yadi dṛśyate akṣata adarśanāt tatra somasya adbhuta darśanam dadhi madhu ghṛtam ca eva juhuyāt ayutam dvijāḥ imam devāḥ iti maṃtreṇa somāya śrapayet carum utpataṃti gṛhe yasya yavāḥ māṣāḥ ca puṣkalāḥ dadhi kṣīra ājya pākeṣu rudhiram dṛśyate yadi vyādhi līnāḥ vinaśyaṃti nikhilāḥ paśu mānuṣāḥ rāja amātya vināśāya gehe gehī vinaśyati prāṇa nāśāya viprāya āhutyā ca prabhavanti hi dṛṣṭvā vābhadram ati ugram juhuyāt ayutam kramāt maṃtreṇa śrapitam lohitam carum tri viprān bhojayet dadyāt dakṣiṇām lohitam tatas svarṇam aṃgāram uddiśya tatas śāṃtiḥ prajāyate puṣpam vā pātayet yatra phalam vā api tathā eva ca hasti aśva mahiṣāḥ gāvaḥ dāra apatya dhanāni ca tuṣṭena aṃgārakeṇa eva sarvam etat pradīyatām āṃgārakeṇa maṃtreṇa khādiram ca akṣataiḥ yutam dhāvanti ca ūrdhva pucchāḥ ca gṛhe gāvaḥ svayam yadi ārohanti gṛham viprāḥ sārameyāḥ ca sūkarāḥ sarveṣām vā bhavet mṛtyuḥ vaṃdhyā gauḥ vā prajāyate mithyā vādena gehī ca rājñā vādaiḥ ca tiṣṭhati dharaṇī hananam yatra dvayoḥ āskadanam tathā nimittāni evamādīni go śva jātāni sattamāḥ maṇḍūka sarpa kūṣmāṃḍāḥ prasuvaṃti yathā striyaḥ śāṃtim tatra pravakṣyāmi yathā saṃpadyate sukham dadhi madhu ghṛta aktam ca apāmārgam tathā punar suvarṇam budham uddiśya gām ca dadyāt payasvinīm suvarṇam puṣpa vṛṣṭim ca suphalam ca akṣatam tathā gṛhe prāṃgaṇake yasya nipatanti kadācana gṛha madhye tu yaḥ paśyet kṣīṇām aṃtarhitām striyam akasmāt mālatī puṣpam jātam syāt tasya vā gṛhe somāya na ca saṃtuṣṭaḥ sarvam etat pradṛśyate dhanam dhānyam tathā putraḥ aiśvaryam ca vara striyaḥ sa bhṛtyāḥ ca mahiṣyaḥ ca mariṣyaṃti na saṃśayaḥ ca mantreṇa apāmārgam tathā budhaḥ payasvinīm tathā gām ca vāsaḥ yuga samanvitam dvijāya śraddhayā dadyāt tatas saṃpadyate śubham siṃha vyāghra gavā ādīnām dhana hāni vipad karaḥ ekaḥ vṛṣaḥ trayaḥ gāvaḥ sapta aṣṭa nava daṃtinaḥ saṃvatsareṇa tasya ekā prasūtiḥ vihatā punar punar punar vratam ca āśu akāle maithunam tathā bhuñjīkṛtāni dhānyāni vrīhayaḥ yava taṃḍulāḥ grāvi mārjāra maṃḍūkāḥ sthūṇā bhaṃge ca prāṅgaṇe gṛhe yasya prajāyaṃte tasyāḥ mṛtyuḥ na saṃśayaḥ ṣaṣ māsa abhyantare yatra śmaśānam yāsyati dhruvam kalaham jñāti vairam ca vyādhi pīḍā bhaviṣyati vipralāpaḥ mitra nāśaḥ iṣṭeṣu aniṣṭa darśanam bhāryā putra vināśaḥ ca bhavet eṣu viniścitam tadā rājñām vibhramaḥ ca tathā gṛha vināśanam amātya vargāḥ ca pure rājñām rājya parāṅmukhāḥ bṛhaspatim samuddiśya gām ca dadyāt payasvinīm vārimaṃḍe ca kūpe ca vāpyām ca madhu kāṃjike kṣīram dadhi ghṛtam ca eva jātam yadi bhaviṣyati akasmāt tatra vṛkṣaḥ ca phalena saha saṃyutaḥ gauram bṛhaspateḥ ca eva prakuryāt prāya dakṣiṇām aśubham hi śubhena eva śāṃtim homam ca kārayet tatra eva rākṣasam yatra ghaṭakam pariśoṣaṇam kesarī śarkarā tailam rājatam tāṃḍavam sthitam māṣa bhaktam tathā dhānyam suvarṇam rajatāni ca tāmram kāṃsyam tathā loham sīsakam pittalam tathā sthāpitāni iva dṛśyaṃte gṛhe ca etāni yasya vai vyādhi pīḍe tathā ghore rāja upadrava baṃdhane gaja aśva paśu bhṛtyānām vināśaḥ jāyate dhruvam yasya etāni pradṛśyaṃte parvataḥ kanakāni ca saṃpad tasya prajāyeta niścalā sukha dā sadā daṃta uttareṣu daṃtāḥ ca paṃktim ākramya saṃsthitāḥ te api doṣa karāḥ sarve kākṛtinaḥ tathā sarve te na te doṣa karāḥ kvacid bhāṃḍe kuṃbhe yadā ca eva śrūyate ghana garjitam kaṃcukānām gṛhe ca eva prākāraḥ śrūyate yadi mūṣikānām mukhe ca eva jvalaṃtī yasya paśyati śāṃtim tatra pravakṣyāmi yayā saṃpadyate śubham śamī patram nirmitam ca yavaiḥ yuktam gṛhiṇī api śukla vāsaḥ yugam ca eva gām ca śuklām payasvinīm devāgāre yadā bhūmiḥ lohitā yasya dṛśyate maṃtriṇaḥ maṃtri putrāḥ ca mriyaṃte na atra saṃśayaḥ yatra vā dṛśyate loke gṛhe yasya su pūjitāḥ puṣpitāḥ ca gṛha staṃbhāḥ śarīram ca ghaṭaḥ tathā hasti aśva mahiṣāḥ ca eva ajāḥ gāvaḥ tathā eva ca nityam svāmi vadha arthāya puṣpitām pravahaṃti ca gṛhe haṃsaḥ gṛhe samyak maṇḍūkāḥ jalacāriṇaḥ sravaṃti pramadāḥ yatra bhinnāḥ te syuḥ nava aṃgikāḥ gṛhī tatra vinaśyeta sa putra paśu bāṃdhavaḥ dhanuḥ khaḍga dharāḥ rātrau madhyāhne cāndrake tathā manuṣya aṅganānām maraṇam tathā syāt rāṣṭra viplavaḥ rasa siddhāni vastūni surā ādyāḥ ca api vā punar hastinaḥ mada yuktāḥ ca aśvāḥ dhīrita hiṃsakāḥ nagare vā tathā grāme jāyante tasya vairiṇaḥ divā vā yadi vā rātrau śaneḥ adbhuta darśanam mṛga vyāghra ādi rakṣāṃsi tathā go mahiṣāḥ api juhuyāt ayutam samyak sasyān ca samidham dvijāḥ śat naḥ devī iti maṃtreṇa śubha artham śanivāsare gām ca nīlām tatas dadyāt jīvat vatsām payasvinīm vāsaḥ yugam ca viprāya suvarṇam rajatam tathā dattvā tu śraddhayā samyak dakṣiṇām śirasi sthitām vidhim homa avasāne tu tatas saṃpadyate śubham yadā dvāre godhikā ca śaṃkhinī praviśet gṛham tadā aśubham vijānīyāt rāja pīḍā dhana kṣayaḥ vinā garjita meghena śilā vṛṣṭiḥ prajāyate rakta miśrā hi pāṃḍuḥ ca patantī yatra dṛśyate tatra saṃdṛśyate ca abhram vṛkṣāḥ vāta vivarjitāḥ divā śivā purā rauti ulūkaḥ vā niśācaraḥ niśi nipatya kākutsthe pradeśe rauti vā vṛṣaḥ adharma prabalāḥ deśāḥ rājā dharma parāṅmukhaḥ anyonyam ca jighāṃsaṃti go brāhmaṇam atha api vā gṛhe gṛhī vinaśyet ca sa putra paśu bāṃdhavaḥ utsānam dvāra deśe asya maraṇam rāṣṭra vibhramaḥ rājya nāśaḥ bhavet rājñaḥ maraṇam vāhanasya ca viparītāni deśāni kramatas saṃbhavaṃti hi rāhuṇā grasta sūryaḥ api niśi ca atha yadā divā tārakā gaṇa vat ca eva rājñām nidhana kārakaḥ saha amātyāḥ vinaśyaṃti svarge ye ca su durjayāḥ para cakreṇa pātyaṃte rājānaḥ na atra saṃśayaḥ chāyā dhvajaḥ ca gagane dṛśyate ced kadācana darśanāt eva rājñaḥ tu vināśaḥ saha rāṣṭrakaiḥ tathā staṃbhe dhūmaḥ eva vā gagane aśani ghātaḥ ca śakti hastena vā punar abdasya abhyaṃtare tasya maraṇam na atra saṃśayaḥ śikhā valaya madhye tu sa dhūmaḥ pāvaka udgamaḥ śavasya nīyamānasya utthānam vā pramādataḥ nirghātaḥ ca api bhūkaṃpaḥ nivāta ulkā pradarśanam akāle puṣpitāḥ vṛkṣāḥ phalam ca akāla saṃbhavam narāṇām āsanam ca eva gavām vā mānuṣī girā pakṣa mātra antare tasya putrasya maraṇam diśet śāṃtim atra pravakṣyāmi yayā saṃpadyate śubham dadhi madhu ghṛta aktam ca kuryāt dūrvā akṣatam tathā carum ca śrapayet tatra rāhum udiśya saṃśrayāt homam kuryāt tatas gām ca kapilām ca payasvinīm atasī tila śaṃkhau vā vāsaḥ yugam atha api vā śraddhayā rāhum uddiśya dadyāt viprāya dakṣiṇām dadhi madhu ghṛta kṣīreṇa vāruṇena ca vāruṇe dṛśyate ca adbhutam teṣu viśiṣṭaiḥ doṣa darśibhiḥ gṛhī tatra vinaṣṭaḥ ca bhavet sa paśu bāṃdhavaḥ dṛśyaṃte tatra krauñcāḥ ca jaṃbukāḥ gṛdhra vāyasāḥ dāruṇam bhīṣaṇam ghoram nṛtyaṃti ca hasaṃti ca mṛtyuḥ tasya bhavet āśu īśvarasya ca śāsanāt sthānāt sthāna aṃtaram yāti bhūmau vā patate bhṛśam sa baṃdhuḥ asyate rājā para cakraiḥ sa pīḍitaḥ durbhikṣam maraṇam ca eva ciram rāṣṭre bhaviṣyati gāvaḥ markaṭa kuṃbhāḥ viśaṃte gṛha veśmani gāvaḥ ca tasya naśyaṃti dāra apatya dhanāni ca anyasya doṣaḥ bhavati gṛhe yānti pramādataḥ śāṃtim atra pravakṣyāmi yayā saṃpadyate śubham viprāya maṃḍapam dadyāt bilva patram atha api vā aiṃdreṇa eva tu mantreṇa homaḥ kāryaḥ dvijātibhiḥ akasmāt śāla tāla akṣa khadira utpala serakāḥ haṃsaḥ vā droṇakākaḥ vā mayūraḥ vā gṛha upari śāṃtim atra pravakṣyāmi yayā saṃpadyate śubham dadhi madhu ghṛta aktam ca juhuyāt ayutam kuśam nīlām dhenum sa vatsām ca bahu kṣīra pradām tathā mṛttikām hema vāsaḥ ca nānā alaṃkāram eva ca dakṣiṇām ca pravakṣyāmi yasya na asti pratikriyā dakṣiṇasyām diśi chāyām yaḥ paśyet ātmanaḥ svayam svacchāyām pādukasya eva paśyet pañcaśiraḥ dvayam uccāvacān pravakṣyāmi yathā śāstreṇa coditam kāka mārjāra śūkānām kapotānām viśeṣataḥ śanim uddiśya juhuyāt ayutam śanivāsare aṣṭāviṃśam carum kṛtvā tatas śāṃtiḥ bhavet dhruvam bhuja padoḥ tathā cakṣuḥ spaṃdane maraṇam diśet tat tu somādbhutam vidyāt vāma dakṣiṇāt kramāt kṛṣṇapakṣe bhavet vāme viparīte adbhutam diśet aniṣṭa sūcakam yasmāt tasmāt śāṃtim prakalpayet śatārddham ravim uddiśya śānti arthe homam ācaret devāgāre tathā godhā śaṃkhinī praviśet kvacid rakta kaṃṭhaḥ kapotaḥ ca vyāghraḥ eṇaḥ ca vā viśet na ca atra gṛha vaikṛtyam hasanam yadi dṛśyate saṃpatti sūcakam gehe maraṇam duḥkha darśanam pramādāt kaṃpane hāniḥ svede jāte vipad bhavet śva jaṃbukau atha vyāghraḥ yathāśakti ca dhāvati īśāne mahiṣaḥ tadvat tadā deśe ca viplavaḥ vṛkṣa adbhutam yadā paśyet tatra tasyām parityajet yad gṛheṣu hutam yāti deśa viplavam ādiśet deśe vā nagare grāme āraṇyapaśubandhanam sarpe vā viparītam ca māṃsa piṃḍam atha api vā tad gṛhe maraṇam ca eva deśa viplavam ādiśet dviguṇam ca api saṃdhyāyām ardharātre caturguṇam akāle tatra maraṇam akāle gṛhiṇī mṛtiḥ saura adbhutam vijānīyāt aśubhe vā viśodhanam sa aṃga upāṃgena sahita maṣṭau aṣṭau hutam ca vā tad mānena hutam viprāḥ kuryāt tatra eva bhūṣaṇam ekaikasya a hutam viprāḥ aṣṭau aṣṭau hutam ca vā adhi prati adhidevānām yāḥ ca anyāḥ ca aṃga devatāḥ māna aṃtam ca dadet pūrṇām dattvā pūrṇām na homayet amāna karaṇe doṣaḥ tasmāt mānam na hāpayet paṃkti catvāriṃśat ādyaiḥ caturdhā vibhajet naraḥ an iṣṭāya tatas dadyāt caru homam vibhāgaśaḥ adhi pratyadhidevānām aṣṭau aṣṭa hi udāhṛtam tryaṃbaka ādiṣu maṃtreṣu homa trayam udāhṛtam dhanaṃjaye tathā dadyāt caru homam vibhāgataḥ ādityāya aṣṭau aṣṭau adhika kalpayet sudhīḥ śata home tu sarvatra daśa aṃgam kalpayet naraḥ aniṣṭāya yuga aṃgam tu grahebhyaḥ hi aṃganāya ca sahasre ca eva viṃśa aṃge aniṣṭāya daśa aṃśakam pañca aṃśena grahāṇām ca pañca aṃśena yavān api tatra aniṣṭe paṃcaśatam tasya ardham graha vāgyataḥ ekatriṃśat bhavet mānam anyeṣām tu caturdaśa ca tithi aṃgam pañca aṃgam yasya ca adbhutam grahebhyaḥ ca eva paṃcāṃgam tatra vā aṃgam parān api eka eka aṃge bhavet mānam ṣaṭśatam ṣaṣṭiḥ eva ca adhikam ca bhavet ṣaṣṭiḥ daśame bhāga śeṣataḥ aniṣṭa aṃśe tri sahasram tri śatam triṃśatam tathā catur śatam grahāṇām ca tathā sapta śata adhikam upagrahebhyaḥ dadyāt ca paṃcāśīti adhikam śatam tithi aṃga bhāgaḥ śeṣeṇa grahe saptaśata adhikam graha aṃge yaḥ sthitaḥ bhāgaḥ yugalam bhāga śeṣataḥ śāṃtike pauṣṭike kāmye yadi icchet sukham ātmanaḥ grahāṇām ca ayutam homam tri aha sādhyena homayet tri aha sādhye vidhānam yat purā eva udīritam dvijāḥ idānīm prakrameṇa eva yaḥ bhāgaḥ sa nigadyate itareṣām grahāṇām ca pratyekam tu śatam śatam adhi pratyadhidevānām paṃcāśat homaḥ ucyate prati grahebhyaḥ tri śatam dadyāt aṣṭa śata adhikam ekāśītim dadau yatnāt aśītim ca aṃtyayoḥ dvayoḥ aniṣṭāya tri śatam tu tṛtīya divase matam tat pratyekam grahāṇām ca dvācatvāriṃśat ucyate adhi pratyadhidevānām pratyekam paṃcatriṃśakam ādityāya yugam dadyāt ekam tu tryaṃbakāya ca grahāṇām tri sahasram tu paṃcānām ca sahasrakam tryaṃbakāya tathā dadyāt tathā dhanaṃjayāya ca ṣaṣ pāda adhika ṣaṣ ṣaṭka sahasra parisaṃkhyayā nava śloka śata udbhūtam saṃpūrṇam syāt bhaviṣyakam viṣaya anukramaṇikā kṛta yuga bhūpa ākhyānam śrī gaṇeśāya namaḥ śaunakaḥ uvāca aṣṭāviṃśe satya yuge ke rājānaḥ abhavan mune teṣām rājyasya varṣāṇi tat me vada vicakṣaṇa sūtaḥ uvāca sa taptvā sarayū tīre tapaḥ divyam śatam samāḥ nārāyaṇam pūjayitvā harau rājyam nivedya ca ṣaṭtriṃśat ca sahasrāṇām abdam rājyam tadā akarot tasmāt jātaḥ vikukṣiḥ ca śata hīnam tat abdakam rājyam kṛtvā divam yātaḥ tasmāt jātaḥ ripuṃjayaḥ śata hīnam kṛtam rājyam tat kakutstha sutaḥ smṛtaḥ śata hīnam kṛtam rājyam tatas anena aṃsaḥ ātmajaḥ śata sahasra hīnam rājyam tat tasmāt jātaḥ prasenajit sahasra hīnam rājyam tat ravaṇāśvaḥ tu tad sutaḥ sahasra hīnam rājyam tat māṃdhātā tad sutaḥ abhavat śata hīnam kṛtam rājyam purukutsaḥ tu tad sutaḥ hīnam rājyam tat tena rājñā ca satkṛtam sahasra hīnam rājyam tat kṛtvā svargam upāyayau tasmāt jātaḥ triśaṃkuḥ ca rājyam varṣa sahasrakam chadmanā hīna tām jātaḥ hariścaṃdraḥ tu tad sutaḥ rājyam viṃśat sahasram ca rohitaḥ nāma tad sutaḥ pituḥ tulyam kṛtam rājyam hārītaḥ tanayaḥ abhavat pituḥ tulyam kṛtam rājyam caṃcubhūpaḥ ca tad sutaḥ bhūpāḥ ca bāhu senā antāḥ vaiṣṇavāḥ parikīrtitāḥ
